Container.Name: hermes-switchui
Container.Overview: Hermes Switch UI bundled with the upstream Hermes Agent gateway in one self-contained container. The UI listens on port 3000; Hermes Agent state persists under /opt/data.
Container.Requires: Set HERMES_PASSWORD before first start. Add at least one provider API key, or configure a local provider from onboarding.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for Hermes Switch UI. Container port must remain 3000.

Config.Name: Hermes Data
Config.Description: Persistent Hermes Agent and Switch UI state: config, sessions, skills, memory, credentials, profiles, logs.

Config.Name: HERMES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required UI login password. Use a strong secret because the app controls terminals, files, agents, and jobs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid file-owner UID for files created in appdata. 99 is nobody on standard Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unraid file-owner GID for files created in appdata. 100 is users on standard Unraid.

Config.Name: API_SERVER_KEY
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for the bundled Hermes Agent gateway. If set, Switch UI uses the same value via HERMES_API_TOKEN.

Config.Name: HERMES_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional gateway bearer token. Leave blank unless API_SERVER_KEY is set; if set, use the same value.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Anthropic provider API key for the bundled Hermes Agent.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional OpenAI provider API key for the bundled Hermes Agent.

Config.Name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional OpenRouter provider API key for the bundled Hermes Agent.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Google/Gemini provider API key for the bundled Hermes Agent.

Config.Name: GROQ_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Groq provider API key for the bundled Hermes Agent.

Config.Name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Mistral provider API key for the bundled Hermes Agent.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when accessing through HTTPS. Keep 0 for normal plain-http Unraid LAN use so login cookies work.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 only behind a trusted reverse proxy that sanitizes forwarded headers.

Config.Name: HERMES_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE
Config.Description: Not recommended. Bypass startup guard if HERMES_PASSWORD is unset on non-loopback bind.
